_comment: Literal values currently baked into the fabric/** reference item definitions (from the original WS_SagarFabric01 workspace). Deploy-ShortcutMonitoring.ps1 replaces each 'literal' with a value it resolves at deploy time (new workspace id, newly-created lakehouse id, etc.) before uploading each item's definition. Do not edit 'literal' values unless the reference fabric/** files themselves change.

tokens.name: EVENTHOUSE_ID
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 05-Eventstream (EH_ShortcutMonitoring Eventhouse item id, created/verified idempotently before the Eventstream is published)

tokens.name: KAFKA_TOPIC_NAME
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 06-Environment: live eventHubName from the newly-created Eventstream's CustomEndpoint source connection

tokens.name: KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 06-Environment: live fullyQualifiedNamespace (+':9093') from the same connection lookup

tokens.name: KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_SECRET_PLACEHOLDER
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 06-Environment: replaced with password="<primaryConnectionString>" from the same connection lookup - the deploy script never prints or logs this value

tokens.name: SOLUTION_WORKSPACE_ID
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 01-Workspace: the solution's OWN workspace id, always - used by NB_OpenLineage_Validate even when deployed into a monitored workspace, since the shared ol_lineage_events_v3 sink table only exists in the solution's own Lakehouse

tokens.name: SOLUTION_LAKEHOUSE_ID
tokens.resolvedFrom: step 03-Lakehouse: the solution's OWN Lakehouse id, always - same rationale as SOLUTION_WORKSPACE_ID

notes: NB_OpenLineage_SparkLineageTest.Notebook is intentionally excluded from automated deployment (config.deployOptionalTestNotebook, default false) - it is a manual ad-hoc diagnostic notebook that also references a second, non-solution scratch lakehouse id not covered by any token.
The Eventstream's Lakehouse destination reuses the LAKEHOUSE_ID/WORKSPACE_ID tokens (no separate token needed).
The Data Agent's datasource.json and the Report's definition.pbir both reuse WORKSPACE_ID/WORKSPACE_NAME/SEMANTIC_MODEL_ID tokens (no separate tokens needed).
